releaseNotes: A version-aware What’s New experience, a new changelog widget, and built-in widget improvements.

changes.title: What’s New widget
changes.detail: See the current KabirUI version on your home screen. Tap the widget to read the full changelog.

changes.title: A changelog for every release
changes.detail: Release notes and individual changes come from the version API, so each published version can show its own changelog.

changes.title: Update banner on first launch
changes.detail: After installing a new app version, a small What’s New banner appears once and can open the full release notes.

changes.title: Liquid glass music widget
changes.detail: See the active track, artwork and progress, with playback controls that adapt to the widget size.

changes.title: Settings for each music widget
changes.detail: Choose whether a widget follows the active player or stays with one player, and adjust its artwork, progress and glass tint.

changes.title: Weather and widget layout fixes
changes.detail: Compact weather cards and built-in widgets adapt to their real grid size, helping their details stay visible.

changes.title: Universal font
changes.detail: Use one typeface across KabirUI screens, built-in widgets and home-screen app labels.
